title: Crispy {p} with {v}
steps: Start the sides in the oven. {starch_how} {veg_how}
Soak the {p} in buttermilk, or milk with a squeeze of lemon, for 15 minutes.
Mix breadcrumbs with a little Parmesan and the {spice}. Press the {p} into the crumbs on all sides.
Air fry at 390°F (200°C) for 10 to 15 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp and {doneness}. Or bake on a rack at 425°F (220°C) for about 20 minutes.
Serve the {p} with the {v} and {s}, and the {sauce} for dipping.
tip: Air frying or baking gives the crunch with a fraction of the oil of deep frying.
